Name: Relativity
Author: adroslice
Description:
This only affects [b]Multiplayer[/b], and has to be installed on every client to work properly. Any client that does not have it installed is not taken into account. Time being slowed/paused only affects the in-game clock, but not things like enemies, NPCs and dropped items.
Examples:
[list]
[*]2 players, one of which is currently looking at a chest: Time passes at half speed.
[*]3 players, 2 of which are currently reeling in a fish: Time passes at 1/3rd the speed.
[/list]This mod was made to make Min/Maxing in Multiplayer easier.
The source code is available on [url=https://git.ulra.eu/adro/sdv-relativity]my gitea[/url].

Manifest.Name: Relativity
Manifest.Description: Slows down multiplayer time based on how many players would normally not have time pass in singleplayer.
Manifest.Author: AdroSlice
